short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Montebello.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Montebello. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Montebello, including North Montebello, South Montebello, Montebello Hills, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Montebello?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Montebello building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Montebello?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Montebello rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Montebello remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
